target_customer: Pharma partners and later drug developers fighting resistance (MRSA, then cancer drug resistance)
problem: Antibiotic and cancer drug resistance undermines treatments; Viosera used combinations of approved drugs to suppress resistance, ResistanceBio applied this to cancer.
business_model: Preclinical drug development, partnering with pharma

founders.name: Nicholas Goldner
education: Washington University in St. Louis, PhD Molecular Cell Biology
founders.background_notes: Sources: YC page and Fifty Years post.

founders.name: Christopher Bulow
education: Washington University in St. Louis, PhD Genomics
founders.background_notes: Sources: YC page and Fifty Years post.

competitors.name: Standard MRSA therapies (vancomycin, daptomycin, telavancin)
competitors.what: Existing antibiotics for MRSA with limited clinical success

technical_complexity.rationale: Preclinical drug development against resistance evolution requires lab and clinical validation.

defensibility.rationale: Science and IP could be a moat, but the lead used off patent drugs in combination.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition reported; sources say the company went inactive by October 2022.

market_need_then: Antibiotic resistant infections such as MRSA had limited effective therapies per a 2018 article.

branding.domain_note: resistance.bio domain, now parked for sale.

rebrands.why: Cancer focused split-off formed in early 2021; name change reason not sourced

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand; domain now for sale.

pivots.why: Company reshaped around cancer in early 2021 per directory sources

outcome_analysis: Viosera was founded in 2016 around a triple beta lactam MRSA candidate, then split off ResistanceBio for cancer drug resistance in 2021 and raised a seed round that databases report as 12M dollars in mid 2022. Sources conflict on whether it is defunct; its domain is parked for sale and databases call it inactive, but no shutdown reason is public.
notes: Website resistance.bio redirects to a GoDaddy for sale page. The 12M seed in July 2022 rests on a single aggregator (StartupIntros, echoed by Dealroom); totals vary from 12.8M to 24.78M across databases, so rounds may be missing. The Fifty Years post dated April 2021 states an undisclosed seed. The YC slug is viosera-therapeutics but the page presents ResistanceBio. The competitor source is dated 2018, before the batch, and covers standard of care only.
